info.name: E-Commerce Platform (e-store)
info.description:
API collection for the e-commerce backend. Built incrementally per the implementation roadmap (docs/ecommerce-platform-plan.md §12) — one folder per app/step, each added and Postman-tested before the next. Currently at Step 0 (infrastructure): no app-specific endpoints yet; only setup and health/status checks.

Collection variables below (baseUrl, tokens, test phones) stand in for a separate environment — set them once when importing.

request.description: Liveness/readiness probe provided in Step 0 — confirms the backend is reachable before any app-specific endpoint exists. App-specific endpoints are added in Step 1 onward.
